evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow… On an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become the victims of bad timing, and are trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. Once awakened, the world around the two of you is no longer the one you remember. With little recollection of what happened, you find yourselves inside a facility of Norček Industries, where the charismatic Director Kathleen Bowe is waiting for you. Her team was on the verge of a breakthrough, but they have mysteriously disappeared, leaving their work unfinished. With a global crisis looming, the Director turns to you and your partner to continue where they left off. To complete their work, you must take on a series of complex tasks throughout the facility. Often separated, you will rely solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. Describe what you see, share what you discover, and combine your perspectives to solve the puzzles that stand in your way. But be cautious; the deeper you venture into the Norček facility, the more questions begin to surface. What is Norček trying to achieve? Why were you brought here? And what happened to those who came before you? Only together will you unravel the mysteries surrounding Norček Industries and discover the truth. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow. Key Features A shared adventure: When fate takes an unexpected turn, two Explorers find themselves trapped inside a mysterious facility. With only each other to rely on, they must uncover its secrets and decide what Tomorrow will hold. Asymmetrical co-op puzzling: No two Explorers experience the facility the same way. Trust your partner, communicate through your walkie-talkies, and combine your unique perspectives to solve puzzles that challenge the rules of time, gravity, and space. Two players, two distinct roles: You and your partner each have a different role to play, with your own high-tech tool at your disposal. Work together and use your equipment in creative ways to overcome obstacles that neither of you could face alone. A mystery in an imagined 80s future: Explore Norček Industries and uncover the secrets behind its experiments and missing research team. Journey through a retro-futuristic world brought to life by striking environments and a nostalgic synthwave soundtrack. The We Were Here Series Every game in the We Were Here Series is a standalone online co-op adventure – the stories are connected but you don’t need to play them in order. Playing with your friend and communicating well is key to the escape room series: asymmetrical puzzles give players different perspectives and can only be solved together. NOTE: This game is co-op only. It requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone and an internet connection. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends. FOLLOW US X: @Infini_Fun About the Game Have you ever dreamed of creating a game masterpiece that defines an era, or moves millions of players? Have you ever imagined standing shoulder-to-shoulder with gaming legends, carving your own name into the annals of gaming history? Welcome to Star of Games, a deeply immersive simulation management game centered around game development. Here, you'll step into the shoes of an ambitious game developer, starting from a small garage studio and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating legends, to creating them, and ultimately changing the world. I. Forge Legendary Games: Start from the Genes In Star of Games, creating games is no longer just about combining genres. We introduce the revolutionary "Game Gene System", allowing you to delve deep into the soul of game design. Deconstruct Legends, Extract Genes : Place iconic titles into your "Gene Decoding Lab." Analyze the core of their success—level design, narrative pacing, game mechanics… everything can be extracted and become the foundation of your own creations. Recombine Genes, Create New Classics : Fuse unique gene sequences and integrate your chosen development philosophy—be it a "player-experience-first" craftsman's approach or a "tech-driven innovation" geek route. Every decision you make will shape the soul of your game. Deep Marketing, Ignite the Buzz : Move beyond simple paid promotions. Build your marketing team and strategize a campaign that engages players, media, and influencers. Will you create mystery, showcase boldly, use scarcity tactics, or rely on word-of-mouth? The market is yours to set ablaze. II. Build a Game Empire: Dance with Legends Personal success is just the beginning—building a great company is the real challenge. In the vast world of Star of Games, you are not alone. Encounter Legends, as Rivals or Allies : Well-known companies will be your inspirations, your competitors, and potential partners. Compete with them for Game of the Year, collaborate to gain tech licenses, or even participate in developing their legendary sequels. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter. Welcome to the U.R.C. — the Unknown Research Consortium. The operation is about to begin. Stay combat-ready. Explore anomalous zones — from abandoned facilities and deserted outposts to forests locked in eternal flame and deadly high-altitude snowfields. Scavenge weapons, medicine, gear, and supplies while recovering ancient artifacts, unknown biological samples, and hidden encrypted documents. Bring back valuable intel, then reach the Extraction Point and return to the Safe House before time runs out. The twisted species emerging within these zones are only one of the obstacles standing in your way. You will also encounter agents from rival factions, mercenaries, and madmen whose minds have been swallowed by the void. When order disappears, the deadliest threat is not always the beast in front of you. Above all else, remember the first rule of every operation: Survive. Use the Gunsmith system to turn whatever you can find into something deadly. Every unorthodox build is yours to test, and the answer will reveal itself the moment you pull the trigger — whether you have created a battlefield-dominating superweapon or a metal coffin that detonates in your hands. When dark violet corruption patterns begin to crawl across the weapon’s surface, it means the gun has broken free from traditional specifications. “Compatibility” no longer applies. You might craft an engineering miracle that defies logic. Or you might end up with a dangerous piece of scrap fit only for an accident report. Even after rigorous training and time spent adapting to this alien environment, an agent’s growth is never complete. Greater strength, agility, and firearm control help you carry more, move faster, and react before the threat does. Every sprint, strike, and shot sharpens your body, instincts, and weapon proficiency. Bring back resources, maintain your gear, reinforce your facilities, and turn that “junk” into another chance to survive. Never underestimate the value of logistics. Once you transform your Safe House into a fortress, your next step into the abyss will be steadier than the last. Venture into Dimensional Fragments alone, or form an exploration squad with up to three other U.R.C. agents for multiplayer missions. Close coordination can greatly improve your extraction rewards and survival odds. Here, watching each other’s backs is not just a virtue. It is essential for survival. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: A pausable real time tactical and resource management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events. War isn't just about combat; It’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines. “The truth is... less than 1% of war is real fighting. The other 99% is just suffering in the trenches — from shellfire, hunger, disease, and rats.” — An unnamed soldier Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a tactical survival and outpost simulation management game driven by various unexpected events on the battlefield. The main inspirations come from Neo Scavenger, Gates of Hell, RimWorld. The story background is inspired by pivotal conflicts in modern history. You will take on the role of the only surviving officer in the company after an enemy airstrike, taking up the responsibility in a crisis, gathering the remnants, and leading the troops through battle after battle to break through the dilemma, gradually growing into an elite force. Gameplay Design It’s more important to play a bad hand well than to be dealt a good one. Through the high-altitude drone combat command platform, you cannot participate in combat personally, but you can observe the real-time situation on the battlefield and quickly update your combat deployments via the drone’s camera. However, there is still a time gap and human factors in the issuing and execution of orders. Sometimes, you must anticipate in advance or radically shift your approach. But plans never keep up with changes — perhaps you should be prepared for your operations to be disrupted. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is dedicated to expressing aspects rarely touched upon by other war games: Detailed classification of logistics work. Machine gun ammo belts must be assembled from loose rounds in the ammo workshop before they can be used by gunners; ingredients are cooked into hot meals in the field kitchen; the severely wounded undergo emergency surgery before being transported to the rear for treatment; fallen comrades are recovered, prepared, and sent back. Customizable armament. In war, the only constant is “change”, and that applies to machines too. Not every piece of armament can function like it came out of the factory. When there are no suitable replacement parts, or when you have two tanks each with different damages, “working” is the only requirement — if it can be fixed, it must not be scrapped! In addition, you can also modify your armament to add new functions to suit different battlefield environments. Soldiers who obey orders but retain individuality. Your soldiers execute combat orders strictly, but may also pick up loot amid the hail of bullets. Besides ammunition, their backpacks may also carry “junk” they can’t bear to discard — if deployed near a river, they might even bring back a big fish for the mess hall in the evening. Balanced nutrition, properly rationed. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare strongly encourages players to enhance the frontline living conditions of their troops in every possible way — and rations are a key part of that. In the game, you can recreate real-world rationing systems used across various theaters of war: rear-echelon logistics personnel receive standard provisions, while frontline combat units are kept well-fed and ready for action. If managing such details isn't your style, this aspect won’t penalize you or block your progress in combat operations. However, better-fed soldiers will fight more effectively and exhibit greater resistance to injuries and illness. *Plenty of protein makes soldiers stronger, vitamins help them fight off infections, a small snack adds a touch of dignity to dinner, and a drink can make even the blandest meal easier to swallow. Battlefield rescue — time is life. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare provides a detailed and smooth battlefield rescue experience. From emergency treatment on the field to the transfer of the wounded, to surgery at the aid point and medical evacuation — you need to quickly judge based on the situation: whether to risk using helicopters to evacuate from the combat zone, or play it safe and use armored vehicles for transport. Having the medical team accompany can also buy more time for the wounded. Although survival ultimately depends on fate, rest assured — Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare will not let your efforts go to waste. Game events with unique perspectives. Receive frontline journalists for interviews. As long as their safety is ensured, the closer they are to the front, the more valuable footage they can get — and the greater the rewards you’ll receive. Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare is a game that tells a war story unique to you. Every action of each soldier under your command will be recorded. Even those who die heroically will be remembered by history. You can set a time range, and the system will automatically collect the combat records of troops during that period and compile them into a battle report, restoring your command orders through text. You can personally name each operation — yes, you are also a part of history. Visual Design In addition to gameplay design, Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare has gone to great lengths to enhance immersion through its visual design. Unit Icons The game's unit icons are based on real-world NATO military symbols. When a unit's equipment changes, the icon automatically updates to reflect its current configuration, accurately representing real-world military notation. You can freely customize different unit types to your liking. (Example: When a recon squad boards a pickup truck, its unit icon will change to that of a motorized recon squad.) Destructible Structures In Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare , buildings are composed of modular rooms that react dynamically to player actions. This means destruction is never the same—no two buildings will (probably...) collapse in exactly the same way. Program Design Multithreaded Optimization of the Pathfinding System You will experience Establish frontline outposts to store supplies and manpower arriving from the rear. Scavenge materials in the ruins of abandoned towns, and transform existing buildings into various military and logistics facilities. Assign soldiers to logistics positions, adjust work priorities and shifts, and automate the operation of the frontline outposts. Form various combat teams to construct your own combat system. Take building clusters as tactical points, relying on solid building cover to engage in tug-of-war battles with the enemy. Arrange logistics and transportation to ensure sufficient supplies to frontline positions. Evacuate the wounded — the faster they receive treatment, the more likely they are to survive. Call for off-field artillery or airstrike support to lay the foundation for infantry assaults. Clean the battlefield and collect spoils; recover the bodies of comrades — we leave no one behind! Recover enemy armament— you may choose to repair and reuse it. Take over special locations in the city (hospitals, factories, etc.) to enhance your logistics base with existing equipment. Adjust food rations to quickly restore morale after large battles. Gather ingredients locally and grow vegetables on wasteland to ensure balanced nutrition for your soldiers. Dig trenches and stockpile supplies to prepare for enemy counterattacks. Maintain your armament to ensure it won't fail in the next battle. Unlock new military policies and weapons to enhance your troops' combat capabilities. Explore new areas, push the frontlines, and face stronger enemies! evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do. Join our community on Discord About the Game S.O.N.A.R. is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine simulator where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Coordinate with your crew, use sonar to detect threats, and operate a cutting-edge submarine through combat operations, stealth infiltrations, and treasure recovery missions. Repair catastrophic malfunctions, recalibrate complex systems, and desperately hope that the person sitting next to you isn't just randomly pressing buttons. UNDERWATER MISSIONS The oceans are under enemy control. Gather a team of highly trained specialists (or at least people who claim they know what they're doing) and complete dangerous missions beneath the waves. - Locate hostile vessels with sonar and send them to the bottom of the sea. Preferably before they do the same to you. - Protect valuable cargo ships. Because apparently the military couldn't find anyone else to babysit them. - Hunt for treasures. Use sonar to search the ocean floor for lost riches, forgotten artifacts, and evidence of previous crews' poor decisions. - Slip past enemy destroyers undetected. Stay quiet. Stay hidden. And whatever you do, don't sneeze. COOPERATION Up to four crew members must work together to manage nine critical stations, including navigation, diving, sonar, periscope operations, engineering, and damage control. Your sonar operator tracks contacts while the rest of the crew keeps the submarine alive. When the sub catches fire or starts taking on water from twelve different holes at once, communication is the only thing standing between you and becoming fish food. Use proximity voice chat to: - Shout urgent orders. - Warn everyone about imminent disaster. - Explain why the catastrophe is definitely someone else's fault. And if a crewmate starts reading the manual during a torpedo attack, give ’em a friendly slap back to reality! Nothing says "successful mission" quite like a victory dance while all hell breaks loose. CUSTOMIZATION In S.O.N.A.R. every character is unique. Choose from dozens of uniforms, hats, and questionable fashion choices. Customize your equipment before deployment and unlock new gear as you level up. If you're going to make terrible decisions underwater, you should at least look good doing it. SURVIVAL Machines aren't the only things that break down. Humans do too. Manage your crew's food supplies, rest schedules, and overall well-being. Neglect them for too long and they'll become exhausted, seasick, delirious, or mysteriously incapable of following simple instructions. Health Tip: You really, really don't want to be vomiting inside your diving helmet when it's your turn to load the torpedoes. Trust us on this one. An opponent's move can trigger the answer you prepared earlier. Set up your counterplays and let them activate when their conditions are met, disrupting the enemy's plans. The bad news? You have no idea how to get home. The good news? You know exactly how to run a restaurant! Roll up your sleeves and earn your ticket back to Earth by doing what you do best: surviving the dinner rush! In this vibrant fantasy world, you'll serve all types of fantastic beings, from burly Orcs, elegant Elves, and grumpy Dwarves to Harpies and even Dragonborns! evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: A tycoon game about building a racing factory from your garage — scavenge, buy or design your own parts, fix cars, and climb every tier of motorsport. Balancing tight finances and decaying parts forces hard calls: repairs, upgrades, or paying the debts to keep the team alive. WORKS: Motorsport Factory is a top-down tycoon sim about everything that happens before a racing car reaches the circuit. Manage a motorsport team from the ground up: staff, facilities, car design and development while trying to stay competitive on a limited budget. Secure sponsors, hire mechanics, source parts and keep the operation running long enough to make it to race day. Five tiers of motorsport stand between your workshop and the being the most prestigious team in motorsport. Progress is not a straight climb - it’s a long-term struggle of financial pressure, technical setbacks and outperforming better-funded rivals. You manage the operation that makes the racing possible. Build the car. Prepare the spares. Manage the crew. Get the right driver in the seat. Load the truck. Get everything out of the factory and to the circuit before the departure deadline. While you wait at the factory the racing happens, watch the timing screens and wait. When the results come in your work begins again worn parts, crash damage and everything you learned about the car. Your crew goes to work. Deliveries arrive. Builders get back to work on the new section of the garage. Every job takes time. Every job needs someone to do it. Where you put things, who you hire, how your workshop is laid out and what your crew is doing right now all matter. The factory isn't a menu. It's a working place. Each part has a story. Each part has a lifespan. A brand new part at race one is not the same at the end of a season. Performance drops off, wear accumulates and eventually a part will fail. Run it too hard and repair it too much and it won't perform the same again. You can design parts for performance, endurance or reliability but getting the right balance to cover all three can be impossible Every part has a breaking point. Every part has a finite mileage lifespan. Every part has a performance drop-off that only reveals itself under real conditions. The better your facilities and the stronger your technical staff, the more of the truth you can uncover. And in a sport where tenths of a second matter, knowledge is often more valuable than raw performance. Five tiers of racing with many routes to reach the top. Whether it's from Karting to Open Wheel or Banger racing to Touring Cars, you're picking the route. Getting into the next series isn't just about winning. Drivers have careers of their own. evidence.chinaDemandEvidence: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop! Easy to pick up, hard to put down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one This Game Is for You If You Enjoy: Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it. down: a xianxia Roguelike blending backpack management, strategic build-crafting, and bullet-heaven shooting. A thousand years ago, a great war between immortals and demons ended in a narrow victory for the immortal realm — but the Gate between realms was shattered. Spiritual energy fell into chaos, and monsters began to roam the world. You stand in humanity’s last sanctuary, built at the only gap in the massive natural barrier known as the Broken Realm Mountains. Outside lies the demon-infested Wildlands of Ten Thousand Monsters. Inside lies the last mortal kingdom. As the senior brother, it is your duty to hold the line and protect the final pure land of humanity. Backpack Like × Strategic Build-Crafting × Bullet-Heaven Shooting Before every wave of demons, you receive a random set of artifacts. You must place, upgrade, and fuse them within a limited backpack grid to survive wave after wave of attacks. Artifacts come in many types, each with its own focus: Some excel at single-target burst Some excel at AoE damage Some excel at healing and sustain Some excel at crowd control and slow Every artifact takes up a different number of grid slots. Making the best use of limited space is a real test of strategy and decision-making. The game features strong backpack like / backpack management gameplay — the deeper you go, the more satisfying it becomes. Artifact Fusion & Evolution — Build Your Ultimate Strategy Some artifacts can evolve into two different types of super artifacts when fused to max level. Choosing the right evolution path and pairing it with different heroes and artifacts is the key to forming a truly powerful build. Will you go for burst single-target damage, or sustained damage over time? Will you snipe one enemy at a time, or clear the entire screen? Every run offers a different answer. Meet Red-Robed Junior Sisters — Build Your Xianxia Team In this xianxia world, you will encounter many junior sisters. Each one is a powerful support with unique abilities and roles, and each is a key factor in clearing high-difficulty stages. Pairing the right sisters with the right artifacts is how you maximize your team’s combat power. Dao Body Upgrade & Star-Up — Don’t Ignore Early Growth While growing stronger as a senior brother, don’t forget to upgrade your Dao Body. Early Dao Body star-up is very important — do not neglect it. The stronger your Dao Body, the more stable your survival and damage output in battle. Accumulate resources in every run so your artifacts, Dao Body, and junior sisters all grow together, allowing you to challenge even higher-difficulty stages. Relaxed, Grind-Friendly, and Deeply Strategic Low PC requirements — runs smoothly on most computers One run after another — easy to enjoy, hard to stop Deep strategy for fans of backpack management, build-crafting, tower defense, and bullet-heaven shooting Xianxia setting + Backpack Like + Bullet-Heaven + Strategy Roguelike — all in one This Game Is for You If You Enjoy: Backpack Like / Backpack Management / Backpack Battles-style gameplay Strategic team-building, build-crafting, and Roguelike randomness Bullet-heaven shooting, tower defense, and screen-clearing horde combat Xianxia / cultivation themes, senior brothers, junior sisters, and Dao Body star-up Relaxed, grind-friendly gameplay that you can enjoy for a long time So then — this last pure land is waiting for you to defend it.
